The only difference is credibility / warranty:

Brackmoor Sound states it is an **"Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty,"** whereas Ottervale Audio makes no such claim.

Since B costs the same and offers the same shipping and returns, there's no downside to choosing the authorized dealer — you're more likely to get a genuine product and have the manufacturer warranty honoured.
